## Contract review

Served-tier: `CONTRACT_REVIEW_TIER`
Head-sha: `4c85d2e00afdf709d7f41b4eed818a6393469afd`
Local-runs: none
Scope: the PR diff at `4c85d2e0` (22 files, +1214/−32: `ui/packages/app-shell/src/views/personalViews.ts`, `ObjectView.tsx`, `objectViewTitleSwitcher.tsx`, `PersonalViewNameDialog.tsx`, the two new test files, the four adjusted `ObjectView.*` doubles, the ten `ui/packages/i18n/src/locales/*.ts` packs, `content/docs/ui/views.mdx`, `.changeset/29635-personal-views-ui.md`), the PR body, card #29635 (body, claim 6592209019, amendment 6592279389, report 6593425827), and on `origin/main`: `packages/platform-objects/src/identity/sys-personal-view.object.ts` (fields L84–130, row scope L77–79), `packages/plugins/plugin-auth/src/personal-view-routes.ts` (the own-row door, L20–90), `ui/packages/auth/src/createAuthenticatedFetch.ts` (L49, L82–88), `ui/packages/app-shell/src/views/runtime-metadata-persistence.ts` (`viewEnvelope` L327–343), `ui/packages/app-shell/src/views/objectViewTabs.ts` (`buildViewConfigSaveBody` L560–577), `ui/packages/app-shell/src/views/RecordDetailView.tsx` L593/L3767 (the unreact-door precedent), `ui/packages/permissions/src/PermissionContext.ts` L93–119, `ui/packages/i18n/src/locales/en.ts` L1368–1400, `ui/packages/app-shell/src/index.ts`

Read-only; nothing was built or run here. CI on `4c85d2e0` was still running when this was written (17 success, 8 skipped, 30 in progress, 0 failure).

### ① Derived judgments

- **The widening is the three i18n keys and nothing else: right.** Each of the ten packs gains `view.switcher.myViews`, `saveAsMyView` and `myViewName` under the existing `switcher` block (the `en` and `zh` hunks read; the other eight are the same four-line shape), so `TranslationKeys` (`typeof en`) gains three members. Every other key the diff reads exists on `main` (`view.rename` L1368, `view.deleteView` L1375, `objectViewActions.renameFailed` / `deleteFailed`, `console.objectView.deleteViewConfirm` / `deleteViewTitle`, `form.saveError`, `common.cancel` / `save`). `@object-ui/app-shell`'s entry exports neither `ObjectViewTitleSwitcher`, `useObjectViewTitleSwitcher`, `personalViews.ts` nor the dialog (`src/index.ts` names none of them), so the switcher's three new optional callbacks, `TitleSwitcherView.personal?` and `personalViewIds` are module-internal, as the changeset says. `Clause-②: yes (widening)` is the truthful form; no accept-set narrows.
- **Every door is the one the server offers a member.** Read: `dataSource.find('sys_personal_view', { $filter: { object_name, user_id }, $orderby, $top: 200 })`, then `readPersonalViewRows` keeps rows whose `object_name` and `user_id` (id or expanded record) are the reader's, because `admin_full_access` reads everyone's; the object's own row scope is `user_id == current_user.id` (L77–79). Create: `dataSource.create` with the four required fields (`user_id`, `object_name`, `label`, `config`; `id` is server-assigned, L84–124). Rename: `dataSource.update(id, { label })`, the object's `nameField`. Delete: `createAuthenticatedFetch({ sameOriginOnly: true })` on `${VITE_SERVER_URL}/api/v1/personal-views/<id>` with `DELETE` and no query, which is `PERSONAL_VIEW_REMOVE_ROUTE` (L88) and the exact shape of the unreact door call at `RecordDetailView.tsx` L3767; the door refuses a query parameter (step 4) and answers another member's id `404`, and the data door's `delete` is never called (test "Rename / Delete", ablation A4). A refused read becomes `status: 'refused'`, which hides the section and Save and draws no error.
- **The saved body is the shape the server validates.** `buildPersonalViewConfig` folds the Filter panel's group with `foldFilterGroupToSpecRules` (a nested group refuses the save, as every explicit save does), applies the reader's column order and hidden columns to `columns` rather than carrying `fieldOrder` / `hiddenFields`, takes the address's `sort` / `grouping` else the view's, and the reader's `rowHeight`; then `buildViewConfigSaveBody(objectName, draft).config` narrows it to `getListViewConfigKeys()` and `viewEnvelope` sets `config.data = { provider: 'object', …, object }` (L341), so `config.data.object` equals `object_name` and the server's `400` (a different object) cannot fire on this path. The entry back into the list (`personalViewEntry`) is the stored body keyed by the row id with the owner's label, `type` defaulting to `grid` as `ListViewSchema` reads it; a row id carries no `.`, so it never names a package view and `resolveViewId` matches the pin exactly.
- **First paint and fallback.** `awaitingPersonalViews` holds the list only while the read is `loading` AND the address or the pin names a view the list does not hold; the refusal probe (`missedViewName`) waits for the same read so a personal id is not probed as a `view` item. Any other open paints at once (ablation A7); a read that never lands is `loading` only for a pinned-or-addressed open, and a deleted pinned view resolves to nothing and falls back (A6); deleting the pinned view clears the pin and leaves an address naming it (`navigate('../..')`).
- **Tests and doubles.** The nine ObjectView cases run the real host and switcher as a non-admin reader, and the six unit cases parse the saved body with spec's `ListViewSchema`. The four adjusted doubles change only the counter's predicate to the list's own object (`object === OBJECT_NAME` / `OBJ`), so the new `sys_personal_view` read is not a list query; no assertion moved (amendment 6592279389 named this class before it was touched).

### ② Semver level

- `@object-ui/app-shell` patch, `@object-ui/i18n` patch, `Clause-②: yes (widening)`, `Metadata-protocol: none`: right. No spec key, metadata key or server route moves; a widening with no protocol change ships `patch` (AGENTS.md step 3); no `!`, no banner, no ADR-0087 marker needed. Both packages whose published tarball changes are listed.

### ③ Boundary flags

- Not Tier H: no governed path. `content/docs/ui/views.mdx` is in-repo prose, not a governed row.
- Dev deviations, each covered: the DELETE call lives in app-shell rather than `@object-ui/data-objectstack` (seat-approved; `index.ts` of that package is under #29634, and the unreact door has the same home); search text, chips and column widths are not stored (none is a `ListView` key); personal views stay out of Manage views (the card's "admin management" is Not in); the new pins are their own file (AGENTS.md ruling 6583487846).
- **Dev open question (Save offered when the reader cannot read the list's object)** — the card's wording is "available to any reader who can read the list (not admin-only)". The PR gates Save on the `sys_personal_view` grants and on no refused view, not on `perms.can(object, 'read')`, so a reader on the list's "You don't have access" state is still offered Save and can store a view of a list they cannot read. Nothing breaks (the row is harmless and the data read stays refused), so this is not a must-fix; it is the should-fix below, and the dev's option B.
- CI was in progress at writing; the seat's pre-landing checks need its green head as usual.

### ④ Design judgment

- Sound. The reader's own rows are user data behind the object's own row scope, read as the owner and filtered again client-side for the administrator's wildcard; the one write the grant model does not allow on the data door (delete) goes through the structural own-row door the server built for exactly this (plugin-auth's docblock L26–44). Reusing `LIST_PINNED_VIEW_PREFERENCE` for "my default" keeps one pin per object and lets the existing resolution open a personal view with no server store. Tried to break it: a stale `settle` after a scope change (guarded on `prev.scope === scopeKey`); a save from a personal view (its `id` is the row id, `viewEnvelope` strips `name`/`label` and rebinds `data.object`); a cross-origin `VITE_SERVER_URL` (refused by `sameOriginOnly`, as the unreact door is); a config stored as JSON text by a driver (`jsonRecord` parses it; a row with no readable body is dropped).

**Must-fix:** none.

**Should-fix (1):** gate `onSavePersonalView` on the list object's read as well (`perms.isLoaded && !perms.can(objectDef.name, 'read')` ⇒ not offered), so Save is not drawn above the list's "You don't have access" state; one predicate, in this PR or a filed follow-up, the seat's call.

Implemented-by: `claude/project-thread-f4qgcg`
Reviewed-by: `session_01QsR2jV5sBSzCYNEDgpYLJw`

**VERDICT: PASS**

## Contract review

Served-tier: `CONTRACT_REVIEW_TIER`
Head-sha: `867962a1169a68b0a31e72cfcd580da88771a526`
Local-runs: none
Scope: the PR's one commit after the passed head (`867962a1`, three files: `ui/packages/app-shell/src/views/ObjectView.tsx` +4/−2, `ui/packages/app-shell/src/views/ObjectView.personalViews-29635.test.tsx` +31/−3, `ui/packages/plugin-form/src/affordanceGrantMap-12082.test.tsx` +5/−0), the merge `cf6a7ccc` of `origin/main` (seven main commits, none touching this PR's files; #29634's data-objectstack change among them), and record 6593489949 (the review of `4c85d2e0`, whose findings carry over unchanged); on `origin/main`: `affordanceGrantMap-12082.test.tsx` L639 (`outOfFamily`), L672–681 (the `useLanguageSelection` precedent) and L1068–1075 (the census assertion)

Delta re-review of the should-fix in record 6593489949. Read-only; nothing built or run. The changeset, both declaration lines, the i18n keys and every door are byte-identical to `4c85d2e0`, so ①, ② and ④ of that record hold.

### ① Derived judgments

- **The should-fix is done as asked.** `listReadable = !perms.isLoaded || perms.can(objectDef.name, 'read')` joins the `onSavePersonalView` predicate beside `personalGrant('create')`, `!!activeView` and `!viewAccess.refusal`; Rename and Delete are untouched, as they should be (they act on rows that already exist). Two host cases pin it: loaded grants refusing `crm_lead:read` draw the My views section and no Save; the CONTROL with the same loaded grants and the object readable draws Save. The permissions mock now answers `isLoaded` and `can` from a hoisted `grants` record reset in `beforeEach`, so the seven earlier cases run as before (unloaded ⇒ allowed).
- **The census entries are the right class.** `affordanceGrantMap-12082` requires every write call site in the tree to have a `WRITE_SITES` entry (L1068–1075), which is why Test UI (14/16) went red on `4c85d2e0` once `usePersonalViews` added two `dataSource` writes. The two new entries name `usePersonalViews > save :: create` and `> rename :: update` as `outOfFamily`, the grade the `useLanguageSelection` entry (L678–679) carries for a write of the caller's OWN row that no browsed record's affordance stands behind; the reasons state the owner scope and the `perms.can(sys_personal_view, …)` gate. The delete is not a data-source write and so has no entry, correctly. Neither `AFFORDANCE_GRANTS` nor any core file moves.

### ② Semver level

- Unchanged: `@object-ui/app-shell` patch, `@object-ui/i18n` patch, `Clause-②: yes (widening)`, `Metadata-protocol: none`.

### ③ Boundary flags

- Not Tier H. The merge brings #29634 (`1c1a5d40`, the one-object view read) onto this branch; it changes `listViews`' source of rows, not its answer shape, and `usePersonalViews` reads `sys_personal_view` through `find`, not the view list, so the two do not interact.
- CI on `867962a1` when this was written:       8 completed/skipped;     11 completed/success;     17 in_progress/null; — the seat's pre-landing checks need its green head, Test UI (14/16) included.

### ④ Design judgment

- Unchanged from record 6593489949. Gating Save on the list object's read closes the one gap that record named; a reader who cannot read the list is offered neither the list nor a view of it.

No must-fix. No should-fix.
